paragraphs.en: The little prince ascended a high mountain, taller than any he knew before, where his previous volcanoes only reached his knees. He used an extinct volcano as a stool and declared, "From such a height, I should see everything at once."
paragraphs.zh: 小王子登上了一座比他以往见过的任何山都高的山顶，他的先前那些火山只到他的膝盖。他把一座已熄灭的火山当成了凳子，说道：“从这样的高度，我应该可以一览无余。”

paragraphs.en: But all he saw were needle-like rock peaks. Greeting the echo, he said, "Good morning," to which it replied, "Good morning--Good morning--Good morning."
paragraphs.zh: 但他看到的只有尖锐如针的山峰。他对着回声喊道：“早上好。”回声应声道：“早上好——早上好——早上好。”

paragraphs.en: "Who are you?" asked the little prince.
"I am all alone--all alone--all alone," echoed back.
paragraphs.zh: “我孤身一人——孤身一人——孤身一人”，回声般响起。

paragraphs.en: He thought, "This is a strange planet—dry and harsh. The people lack imagination; they just repeat what I say."
paragraphs.zh: 他心想：“这真是个奇怪的星球——干燥而严酷。人们缺乏想象力，只是机械地重复我的话。”

paragraphs.en: Recalling his flower on his own planet, he mused, "She was always the first to speak..."
paragraphs.zh: 回想起自己星球上的那朵花，他沉思道：“她总是第一个开口……”
